title: Learning Fair Representations via Rate-Distortion Maximization

bias_targets.methodology: Probing representations with a non-linear classifier (MLP) to predict gender, measuring Minimum Description Length (MDL) and accuracy, and calculating group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, TPR-GAP) on downstream tasks like profession classification. Also evaluated via k-means clustering separability on word embeddings.

Probing text representations to predict race (based on African-American English vs. Standard American English dialects) using a non-linear classifier, and measuring Demographic Parity and TPR-GAP on a downstream sentiment classification task.
Probing text representations with a non-linear classifier to predict age, and measuring Demographic Parity and TPR-GAP on a downstream mention detection task.

Probing representations for combined protected attributes (e.g., age and gender simultaneously) using a non-linear probing network to measure F1 score and Minimum Description Length (MDL) of the intersectional groups.
